title: StitchVector POC-01 R2 amendment 1 (pushed and remote-verified BEFORE the new R2 code runs)
supersedes: R2.progressive.repair (geometric difference + snap). Old R2 results and the frozen failure scene (cae2e50) are kept as FAILED_V1; nothing is overwritten.
deviation_recorded: PREREGISTRATION_REMOTE_FREEZE_DEVIATION: commits a9813b4..e1a0962 were local only until pushed on 2026-10-30 after the runs; see docs/research/stitchvector/recovery_report.md
scope: ONE real sample only: u2 centre 300x300 (same crop as the failure scene), 32-colour quantization, variant A (direct mosaic). No matrix.

representation.label_image: quantized integer labels; every pixel has exactly one label; all repair decisions are made on this grid
representation.arc_network: unit pixel edges where the label differs (plus the window border) are chained into arcs between nodes (vertex degree != 2 or a change of the left/right label pair). Each arc is stored once and shared by its two faces.
representation.simplification: each arc is simplified independently with fixed endpoints (shapely simplify, preserve_topology=True) at its own tolerance; shared boundaries are therefore identical for both faces by construction
representation.faces: polygons are rebuilt from all arcs with shapely.polygonize; each face takes the label image value at its representative point

progressive.rule: start with every arc at 4 px; rebuild faces and rasterize; residual = pixels whose rendered label != label image; arcs passing within 1.5 px of a residual pixel drop to the next tolerance; repeat until 0. Arcs with no nearby residual keep their larger tolerance (this is the progressive part; it is NOT a full re-polygonization at a finer tolerance).
progressive.validity_fallback: if the rebuilt arc network is invalid (face count or area mismatch, crossing arcs), the arcs involved drop straight to tolerance 0; counted and reported

checks.raster_partition: rendered labels == label image on 100% of pixels at the end
checks.vector_topology: shapely.coverage_is_valid(faces) == True (strict shared-edge rule), area sum == union area == window
checks.note: these are reported separately: raster correctness does not imply GIS topology

comparison_same_input_same_final_accurac.single_pass_tol0: all arcs at 0 (exact) - same final accuracy as progressive
comparison_same_input_same_final_accurac.single_pass_tol1: all arcs at 1 px - reported with its residual
comparison_same_input_same_final_accurac.progressive_worth_it_if: progressive reaches 0 mismatch with fewer vertices than single_pass_tol0; if not, say so

stop_rule: if the one sample cannot reach both checks within 10 min CPU, report FAIL and propose R1 + local pixel fallback; no further patching
